title: Frog heart: cardiogram and drug responses
goals: Interpret a historical cardiac mechanical recording in its original orientation
Identify beats and explain effects on rate and amplitude without assuming uncalibrated force
Distinguish electrical ECG from mechanical heart cardiogram
Consider lever attachment and inversion of upward or downward deflections
sample_preparation: Frog heart, exact preparation must be confirmed in each source
tasks: Annotate a baseline and two consecutive cardiac cycles
Identify the location and limitations of the adrenaline intervention
State why an upward deflection is not automatically ventricular systole without apparatus metadata
interpretation_warning: The historical Wikimedia scan's quantitative calibration is not established. No inverted cardiogram is manufactured to conform to a textbook convention.
